title: Creation Sort Cards
purpose: Help children notice order and variety in Genesis 1.
body_markdown:
# Creation Sort Cards

Cut into cards or read them aloud. Ask children to place them into a sensible Genesis 1 sequence.

- Light and darkness
- Sky and waters
- Dry land and plants
- Sun, moon, and stars
- Sea creatures and birds
- Land animals

## Teacher key

Genesis 1 presents an ordered progression. The purpose is observation and retelling, not a technical chronology debate.
